source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned opening without adding Son of God from the variant.
key_decisions.before: The beginning of the good news of Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.after: The beginning of the good news of Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The beginning of the good news of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Isaiah attribution and the messenger’s preparatory role.
key_decisions.before: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “Look, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way;
key_decisions.after: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “Look, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way;

key_decisions.rationale: Lineates the wilderness summons while keeping the road image.
key_decisions.before: a voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way of the Lord; make his paths straight.’”
key_decisions.after: “A voice cries out in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the Lord’s way; make his paths straight.’”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: a voice crying in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way of the Lord; make his paths straight.’”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves immediate perception, torn heavens, and simile rather than identifying the Spirit as a bird.
key_decisions.before: As soon as he came up out of the water, he saw the heavens being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
key_decisions.after: As he came up out of the water, he immediately saw the heavens being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And immediately, as he came up out of the water, he saw the heavens being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned shorter reading without adding an entry verb absent here.
key_decisions.before: They went into Capernaum, and on the Sabbath Jesus entered the synagogue and began to teach.
key_decisions.after: They went into Capernaum. On the Sabbath he immediately began teaching in the synagogue.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And they went into Capernaum. And immediately on the Sabbath he entered the synagogue and was teaching.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the purpose and ambiguous came-out expression rather than specifying a heavenly origin.
key_decisions.before: He said to them, “Let us go somewhere else, to the nearby towns, so that I may proclaim there too. This is why I came out.”
key_decisions.after: He answered, “Let us go elsewhere, to the nearby towns, so I can proclaim the message there too. That is why I came out.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he said to them, “Let us go on to the neighboring towns, so that I may proclaim there also, for this is why I came out.”

key_decisions.rationale: Follows pinned anger without substituting the compassion variant or inventing an object for the anger.
key_decisions.before: Moved with anger, Jesus reached out his hand, touched him, and said, “I am willing. Be made clean.”
key_decisions.after: Moved to anger, Jesus reached out his hand and touched him. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand and touched him and said to him, “I am willing. Be made clean.”

key_decisions.rationale: Retains silence, priestly presentation, offering, and the open-ended testimony phrase.
key_decisions.before: He said, “See that you say nothing to anyone. Go, show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing what Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”
key_decisions.after: “See that you tell no one anything,” he said. “Instead, go, show yourself to the priest, and offer what Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
